title: Docker A-Z Handbook
subtitle: Complete Docker mastery from fundamentals to production CI/CD pipelines
description: An A–Z field guide for developers who containerize their apps and DevOps engineers who run them in production. 19 chapters covering Docker architecture, Dockerfile syntax, multi-stage builds, persistent volumes, bridge networking, Docker Compose, security hardening, and GitHub Actions CI/CD automation.

title: GitHub A-Z Handbook
subtitle: Complete Git & GitHub mastery from fundamentals to production workflows
description: A comprehensive, practical handbook covering GitHub from foundational basics to advanced DevOps concepts. Includes Git branching strategies, CLI commands, pull request workflows, merge conflict resolution, CI/CD automation, and repository management for Developers and DevOps engineers.
